# Peacock Studio

> Peacock Studio turns real browser workflows into editable Flow Documents and Product Tours — interactive documentation with screenshots, branches, PDF export, and local-first storage.

Peacock Studio is a browser flow recorder and interactive documentation platform. Capture clicks, inputs, and screenshots with a Chrome extension, then edit and share guided docs or persona-led tours. Data stays local by default (IndexedDB); optional cloud sync is available when configured.

Primary site: https://peacock.mentorbridge.in

## Products

- [Flow Documents](https://peacock.mentorbridge.in/products/flow-documents): Step-by-step workflow guides with screenshots, sections, branches, and share links
- [Product Tours](https://peacock.mentorbridge.in/products/product-tours): Persona-led journeys that bundle flow documents into guided stories
- [Capture Screenshot & Editor](https://peacock.mentorbridge.in/products/capture-screenshot-editor): Visible, selected, or full-page screenshots with crop, blur, and redact
